coords: three.js world metres (X east, Y up, Z south). Add the GLB at the origin with no transform; every node carries only a translation (its pivot).

nodes.pivot: mesh-less pivot node (survives quantization); geometry in child ChimneyTop_Geo
mesh-less pivot node (survives quantization); geometry in child Cottage_Door_Geo
mesh-less pivot node (survives quantization); geometry in child Garden_Gate_Geo

notes.ChimneyTop: Mesh-less node at the flue exit (top centre of the south chimney pot): emit chimney smoke at its world position. The pot itself is the child ChimneyTop_Geo.
notes.Cottage_Door: Mesh-less pivot on the front door hinge axis (vertical), child Cottage_Door_Geo = the leaf. rotation.y < 0 swings it inward (into the house); closed = 0.
notes.Garden_Gate: Mesh-less pivot on the gate hinge axis (north gate post of the west fence, facing the pond), child Garden_Gate_Geo. rotation.y > 0 swings it into the garden; closed = 0.
notes.Cottage: Walls, thatch (M_Thatch + M_ThatchRidge + hazel liggers M_Hazel), chimney, windows (Window_Glass), porch hood, back outshot. Pivot = floor centre (56, 2.1, -30).
notes.Garden: Raised beds (cabbages, onions, runner beans on hazel poles, lettuces), brick path with dog-tooth edging, hollyhocks + lavender, water butt, wheelbarrow. M_Plants = one double-sided material over a 256 px palette (alphaTest not needed).
notes.Garden_Fence: Picket fence 0.92 m, posts every <= 2.1 m sunk 0.5 m; pickets and rails follow the ground per post / per picket.
notes.layout: Garden west fence sits at garden-local x = -3.3 (not -6): from -6 to -3.4 the layout rectangle is the pond bank / water (ground -0.3..1.1). East side of the garden is closed by the cottage front; short fence returns meet the house corners.
notes.groundContact: Foundations, plinth, steps, posts, bed boards and the butt stand all extend 0.25-0.5 m below the lowest ground sampled from src/world/gen.js (seed 7).
notes.materials: Window_Glass is opaque dark glass. Hazel/plant/door/paint materials share images with M_Oak (baseColorFactor tints).

channels.r: baked ambient occlusion (Cycles, incl. terrain contact)

vertexColors.warning: GLTFLoader sets material.vertexColors = true when COLOR_0 exists, which would tint by the masks. Set it false and read the attribute as data (same convention as mill.glb).
